standalone_rule: Clone, core install, build, test, deterministic run, and release must not require sibling repositories, .aoa, OS skill profiles, shared validators, shared runtimes, or hidden host configuration.

entries.surface: Perception -> Interpretation -> World/Memory -> Response/Plan -> optional Action/Voice -> Trace
entries.reason: This is the product, composition, and acceptance boundary.

entries.surface: file-backed retrieval, product KAG, mutable state, append-only traces
entries.reason: Preserve citations and deterministic replay while separating state from evidence.

entries.surface: scripts/*.py with sys.path injection and scripts.* imports
entries.target_owner: thin wrappers over atm10_agent.cli or deletion
entries.reason: Runnable behavior belongs behind one installable package and composition root.

entries.surface: gateway SLA readiness, governance, progress, transition, remediation, integrity, and operating-cycle layers
entries.target_owner: none; retain only product-relevant degraded and trace semantics
entries.reason: This control plane became an architectural center unrelated to the companion turn.

entries.surface: nine requirements files without installable-project metadata
entries.target_owner: pyproject.toml plus reproducible resolved dependency artifact
entries.reason: The project needs one build contract and explicit optional extras.

entries.surface: ATM10 window identity, DXcam/Pillow capture, PowerShell launch
entries.current_owner: pilot runtime and host profile modules
entries.reason: Windows remains first-class acceptance evidence but cannot prevent stub/replay use elsewhere.

entries.surface: OpenVINO vision, grounded response, ASR, and device placement
entries.reason: OpenVINO is a validated provider, not the core architecture.

entries.surface: OpenAI and future Gemini-compatible model providers
entries.reason: Remote providers must be replaceable and absent from deterministic acceptance.
The file-backed world remains the standalone default.
Product KAG semantics stay; the database backend is additive.
HTTP and UI may expose a companion turn but may not own or multiply it.

entries.surface: ASR, TTS, microphone, and audio playback
entries.reason: Text and replay remain complete when voice is unavailable.

entries.surface: OS user-profile skills as a repository operating dependency
entries.reason: Maintainer tools may be used, but ATM10 cannot require their presence or contracts.

entries.surface: .aoa and aoa-memo routes in repository guidance
entries.target_owner: repo docs, git history, local state, and local traces
entries.reason: Continuity of the product and its maintenance must be source-owned.

entries.surface: root kag/ provider and generated repository index family
entries.target_owner: none; src/kag product graph remains separate
entries.reason: Repository self-indexing is not the companion world model and currently requires an external owner.

entries.surface: aoa-stats checkout, schemas, and validate_local_stats_port delegate
entries.target_owner: owner-local measurements and tests, if retained
entries.reason: Useful measurement meaning can stay without a required sibling validator.

entries.surface: skeleton eval port routed to aoa-evals
entries.target_owner: ATM10 fixture-first eval and regression lane
entries.reason: ATM10 needs local verdicts over its own companion contract.

entries.surface: selected eval cases, scoring ideas, or validators
entries.reason: Allowed only after standalone autonomy is green and intake is pinned and reviewed.

entries.surface: selected KAG, memo, world, routing, stats, or runtime discipline
entries.reason: Donors inform the monolith; they never become live dependencies.
